meta.name: strategic-compact
meta.description: Suggests manual context compaction at logical intervals to preserve context through task phases rather than arbitrary auto-compaction.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 在任务阶段手动压缩上下文以保持关键信息
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在复杂任务中手动管理上下文避免丢失
copy.tagline_en: Manually compact context at logical intervals to preserve key information
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to manually manage context to avoid losing information in complex tasks

howto.what: 在长对话中，Claude 会在逻辑节点（如完成研究、切换任务）主动建议你手动执行 /compact 压缩上下文，而不是依赖自动压缩。
howto.when: 当对话接近上下文限制（200K+ tokens）、完成一个里程碑、或响应变慢时触发。

say.text: 帮我压缩上下文，保留当前计划。
say.note: Claude 会建议在合适时机执行 /compact。

say.text: 完成研究阶段，准备开始编码，建议压缩。
say.note: Claude 会提示压缩以释放上下文空间。

howto.what_en: In long sessions, Claude proactively suggests manual /compact at logical boundaries (e.g., after research, before task switch) instead of relying on arbitrary auto-compaction.
howto.when_en: Triggered when approaching context limit (200K+ tokens), after completing a milestone, or when responses slow down.

say_en.text: Compact context, keep the current plan.
Finished research phase, ready to code, suggest compaction.
say_en.note: Claude will prompt to free up context.
